name: Sangoku Hime 3 ~Tenka Shinsei~
source:
This is a continuation of the Sangokuhime series, with over 350 generals. In addition to the three kingdoms, there’ll be routes for Kouhosuu Gishin (Huangfu Song) and Ryofu Housen (Lu Bu). In the new battle system, up to 18 units can fight simultaneously and there are 6 different general types, which adds more balance. There are also 16 different types of troops which can be employed.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/09/27/september-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是三国姬系列的延续，拥有超过350名将军。除了三个王国之外，还有Kouhosuu Gishin（皇甫嵩）和Ryofu Housen（吕布）的路线。在新的战斗系统中，最多可以有18个单位同时战斗，并且有6种不同的武将类型，增加了更多的平衡性。还有16种不同类型的部队可供使用。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/09/27/september-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
